correctness.rationale: In a simple cubic triangle-free prism, sensors pairwise farther than three produce noninteracting closed neighborhood stars with no force; a close pair seeds adjacent complete rungs that propagate. Gap counting with an even number of rail changes gives all coefficients and a two-state transfer matrix independently recovers the generating function. A Lucas factorization yields exact totals. A degree-eleven bounded-dependency pair-count Poisson argument proves the sparse critical window. Brute graph closure for all 349,440 subsets at n=4..9, formal coefficients through n=160 and Lucas totals independently corroborate the derivation; full proofs are in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: A complete labelled all-cardinality power domination polynomial is a natural graph invariant and resolves sensor-set reliability for the classical circular ladder, rather than reiterating the known scalar minimum or failed maximum. The exact Lucas count and nontrivial corrected parity/ternary residues, plus the sharp n^-1/2 observation threshold with Poisson constant 11, give structural and stochastic insight with direct relevance to resilient monitoring.
